description: This Java source file defines the ServiceEcaArtifactInfo class, which models information about Service ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for populating related services, generating display names, and creating EO model maps.

classes.name: ServiceEcaArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a Service ECA rule, including its related services, display properties, and EO model map generation.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the set of services called by this Service ECA rule and updates referring info.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the Service ECA, based on its prefix and suffix.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the string 'Service ECA' as the display type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for Service ECA info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique string identifier for this Service ECA rule.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the Service ECA definition.

methods.name: getDisplayPrefixedName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the display name with prefix, service name, event name, and suffix.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByServiceEcaActions
methods.description: Returns the set of services called by this Service ECA.

methods.name: getServicesTriggeringServiceEca
methods.description: Returns services that trigger this Service ECA.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Creates a map representing the EO model for visualization, including properties and relationships.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the underlying ServiceEcaRule.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the string representation.
